solids_note: the skid chain (plinth, stand, vessel, insulation envelope, pump envelope, recirculation loop, drain and vent) fuses to one solid; the four face-stub connections (N1, N2, N3, N6) are the CATCH_TANK-idiom face hardware and stay separate until the connecting lines make their joints; every solid closed and manifold
